question.text: What will be the normality of the salt solution obtained by neutralising $x$ mL. $y$ (N) HCl with $y \quad$ mL $x$ (N) $\mathrm{NaOH}$, and finally adding $(x+y) \mathrm{mL}$ distilled water

solution.text:
The reaction for given reaction is $\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{NaOH} \longrightarrow \mathrm{NaCl}+\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}$
Number of moles  	xy	xy	0	0
Added 		$\quad N V \quad N V$
Number of moles left 0 	0 	xy	xy
$\therefore N($ solution $)=\frac{\text { Number of milliequivalent }}{\text { vol. of solution in mililetre }}$
